name.description: Module identifier. Must equal the parent directory name.

version.description: Module's own semver. Independent of bridge_version.

entry_point.description: Python file relative to the module dir.

default_tier.description: Optional D7 complexity hint. References a key in settings.yaml::tiers (typically 'basic', 'normal', 'flagship', but vault-author tiers are allowed).

schema_examples.description: Few-shot file relative to the module dir.

source_id_from.description: Maps each sources.yaml top-level key to the record field used as source_id (FR-013b). Example: {"youtube_channels": "url", "github_repos": "path"}.

user_owned.description: Relative paths preserved on vault update if present (FR-025). sources.yaml is always preserved unconditionally.

extraction_timeout_seconds.description: Per-source hard wall-clock budget for the extractor subprocess (R21). Optional. Default 600. Vault authors can override via settings.yaml::stages.source_extraction.timeout_seconds.

bridge_compat.description: Reserved for future use. D6 currently does atomic refresh, not compat checks.

preflight.description: Per-module preflight subprocess (spec 051 FR4). REQUIRED. Spawned once per cycle to validate this module's sources.yaml before extraction.

entry_point.description: Preflight script relative to the module dir (e.g. 'preflight.py'). Mirrors the top-level extractor entry_point.

timeout_seconds.description: Wall-clock cap for the preflight subprocess, enforced via terminate_process_tree.

authentication.description: Optional env-var credentials this module requires (spec 038 FR-001/013). Absent, ``none``, or empty env_vars ⇒ no credentials needed.

env_vars.description: Environment variables that MUST be set for this module. Each is MANDATORY when declared.

rate_limits.description: Optional rate-limit declaration (spec 038 FR-003). v1 is declare-only; client-side enforcement deferred.

failure_policy.description: How the orchestrator handles module failures (spec 038 FR-004). Absent ⇒ block_cycle.
